title: Leaf spaces and transverse structures — Question 8.1
exact_target: Determine when a nontrivial real-line action of an irreducible manifold group can be geometrically realized by a taut foliation with real transverse coordinates.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10300024 (AMR-102-0024). CC BY 4.0.
